music_policy: Original acoustic ensembles and faulty public address: cheap brass, plucked strings, detuned keyboard, hand percussion and mechanical rhythm. No licensed song, sampled film line or imitation of a referenced soundtrack. The composer records the exact pitches of an original two-note rise and unresolved descending answer: cheerful for receipts, satisfied rather than heroic for the ending. Return to exploration after combat without implying certification; a boss phase accent does not restart its track.

mix.policy: Mono retains essential cues; source icons or directional captions accompany essential sound. Receipt stingers never suppress warnings. Pause and ledger suspend gameplay loops and tails; focus loss freezes vocals and music. Reduced dynamic range never raises the peak ceiling.
